correctness.rationale: At level ell, the zero-diagonal lifted Hamiltonian is block off diagonal between V(HK_{ell-1}) and the two new midpoints per old edge. Proposition 2.15 and layer-degree constancy make the old-to-new block diagonally equivalent, after deleting duplicate columns, to the ordinary unsigned incidence matrix of HK_{ell-1}. A connected bipartite graph has unsigned-incidence rank |V|-1. Thus rank H_ell=2(|V(HK_{ell-1})|-1), and substitution of |V(HK_j)|=(2*4^j+4)/3 gives nullity (4^ell+2)/3=|V(HK_ell)|/2. The off-diagonal block form pairs nonzero eigenvalues by sign, and self-adjointness makes zero semisimple, yielding the IDS values 1/4 and 3/4.
